events.command:
python3 -c "
# Galaxy-computed means
dlasR_mean = 23920.0
wt_mean = 82442.333333333

# Percent reduction = (WT - mutant) / WT * 100
percent_reduction = (wt_mean - dlasR_mean) / wt_mean * 100
print(f'ΔlasR mean: {dlasR_mean}')
print(f'WT mean: {wt_mean}')
print(f'Percent reduction: {percent_reduction:.2f}%')
print(f'Rounded: {round(percent_reduction)}%')
print(f'One decimal: {percent_reduction:.1f}%')
"
